GPU 0 上有一个独立进程 PID 315052（或 315057）在跑 c8 LLaMA importance s025（n=250），输出到 `profiling_output_c8_llama_importance_s025/`。
同时主脚本 `run_c8_llama_n250_fixed.sh`（PID 310712）在 GPU 2+3 上跑，round 2 也会跑 importance_s025 并写入**同一目录**。
主脚本 skip 逻辑只检查 `profiling_results.json` 是否存在——如果 GPU 0 还没写完，主脚本 round 2 会并发写入同目录，导致数据损坏。

## 你的任务

### Step 1: 诊断（用 ssh_read_only）
```bash
# 1a. GPU 0 进程状态和进度

ps -p 315057 -o pid,stat,etime,cmd 2>/dev/null || echo "PID_315057_GONE"

ls -la /root/autodl-tmp/pacs/profiling_output_c8_llama_importance_s025/ 2>/dev/null | head -20
# 检查已完成多少题
ls /root/autodl-tmp/pacs/profiling_output_c8_llama_importance_s025/*.json 2>/dev/null | wc -l

# 1c. 检查 profiling_results.json 是否已存在（skip 触发条件）
ls -la /root/autodl-tmp/pacs/profiling_output_c8_llama_importance_s025/profiling_results.json 2>/dev/null

ls /root/autodl-tmp/pacs/profiling_output_c8_llama_importance_s020/*.json 2>/dev/null | wc -l
tail -10 /root/autodl-tmp/pacs/logs/c8_llama_n250_fixed.log 2>/dev/null

# 1e. GPU 利用率
```

**如果 GPU 0 s025 进度远远领先（比如 > 200/250），预计在主脚本到 round 2 前完成** → 方案 B，不改脚本。但必须计算时间窗口确认。

```bash
# 在每个条件的 skip 检查前加：
# 如果有活跃进程在写同目录，等待完成
while fuser "$OUTPUT_DIR"/*.json >/dev/null 2>&1 || pgrep -f "profiling_output_c8_llama_${CONDITION}" >/dev/null 2>&1; do
    echo "Waiting for concurrent process in $OUTPUT_DIR to finish..."
    sleep 60
done
```

{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
# Fixed c8_llama_n250: 8 conditions on GPU 2-3, 1 condition/GPU, 4 rounds
# Fixes: pipefail for exit code propagation, output validation, GPU monitoring
# Bug in original: `| tee` masked Python crashes; no output validation
set -euo pipefail
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
cd /root/autodl-tmp/pacs

MODEL="checkpoints/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B"
DATA="data/math500.json"
N=250
TOKENS=8192
MPL=10
FAILED=0

mkdir -p logs

# GPU monitoring (background)
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,timestamp,memory.used,memory.total,utilization.gpu --format=csv -l 60 > /tmp/c8_gpu_monitor.log 2>&1 &
GPU_MONITOR_PID=$!
trap "kill $GPU_MONITOR_PID 2>/dev/null" EXIT

run_one() {
    local gpu=$1 method=$2 sparsity=$3
    local sp_str=$(printf "s%03d" $(python3 -c "print(int(float('$sparsity')*100))"))
    local outdir="profiling_output_c8_llama_${method}_${sp_str}"
    local logfile="logs/c8_llama_${method}_${sp_str}.log"

    if [ -f "$outdir/profiling_results.json" ]; then
        echo "$(date) SKIP: $outdir already complete"
        return 0
    fi

    # Clean stale empty dir
    [ -d "$outdir" ] && rmdir "$outdir" 2>/dev/null || true

    echo "$(date) START: gpu=$gpu method=$method sparsity=$sparsity -> $outdir"
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$gpu python3 -m pacs.profiling.run_profiling \
        --model_path "$MODEL" \
        --data_path "$DATA" \
        --output_dir "./$outdir" \
        --sparsity_levels "$sparsity" \
        --masking_method "$method" \
        --max_new_tokens $TOKENS \
        --min_phase_length $MPL \
        --max_problems $N \
        --save_generations \
        --gpu 0 \
        > "$logfile" 2>&1
    local rc=$?
    if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then
        echo "$(date) FAILED: $outdir exit_code=$rc"
        tail -20 "$logfile"
        return $rc
    fi

    # Validate output
    if [ ! -f "$outdir/profiling_results.json" ]; then
        echo "$(date) FAILED: $outdir/profiling_results.json not found after run"
        return 1
    fi
    local fsize=$(stat -c%s "$outdir/profiling_results.json")
    if [ "$fsize" -lt 100 ]; then
        echo "$(date) FAILED: $outdir/profiling_results.json too small (${fsize} bytes)"
        return 1
    fi
    echo "$(date) OK: $outdir ($(du -sh "$outdir" | cut -f1))"
}

run_round() {
    local round_num=$1
    local gpu_a=$2 method_a=$3 sparsity_a=$4
    local gpu_b=$5 method_b=$6 sparsity_b=$7

    echo ""
    echo "========== ROUND $round_num =========="

    run_one $gpu_a $method_a $sparsity_a &
    local pid_a=$!
    run_one $gpu_b $method_b $sparsity_b &
    local pid_b=$!

    local fail=0
    wait $pid_a || { echo "$(date) Round $round_num: GPU $gpu_a task failed"; fail=1; }
    wait $pid_b || { echo "$(date) Round $round_num: GPU $gpu_b task failed"; fail=1; }

    if [ $fail -ne 0 ]; then
        echo "$(date) Round $round_num FAILED — aborting"
        FAILED=1
        return 1
    fi
    echo "$(date) Round $round_num DONE"
}

echo "$(date) Starting c8_llama_n250_fixed (GPU 2+3, 4 rounds)"

run_round 1  2 importance 0.15  3 importance 0.20
run_round 2  2 importance 0.25  3 importance 0.30
run_round 3  2 random 0.15     3 random 0.20
run_round 4  2 random 0.25     3 random 0.30

if [ $FAILED -eq 0 ]; then
    echo ""
    echo "$(date) ALL 8 CONDITIONS COMPLETE"
    echo "Output dirs:"
    for d in profiling_output_c8_llama_*/; do
        echo "  $d: $(du -sh "$d" | cut -f1)"
    done
else
    echo ""
    echo "$(date) SOME CONDITIONS FAILED — check logs"
    exit 1
fi
